user.title: Connect to E.ON Next
user.description: E.ON no longer accepts passwords through the meter API. Import a refresh token from a dedicated private/incognito E.ON sign-in, then close that window before submitting here. Do not reuse a browser session that will continue refreshing. The credential has normal account access; this integration only queries meter data. Home Assistant stores the rotating refresh token, never your password. See the README for instructions.

init.title: Tariff settings
init.description: Gas conversion uses m³ × 1.02264 × calorific value ÷ 3.6. Enter your bill value (37–43), or 0 to keep native volume. Converted gas kWh and costs are estimates. Converted gas recalculates the configured history window on every update; other tariff changes recalculate 14 days. Older records outside these windows remain unchanged.
